feed.title: Bruce A. Desmarais
feed.subtitle: Bruce A. Desmarais is the DeGrandis-McCourtney Early Career Professor in Political Science at Penn State, Director of the Center for Social Data Analytics, and co-founder of Public Square Analytics (GovFeeds). His research develops machine learning, network analysis and AI methods to study policymaking and digital communication with public officials.

entry.title: palsr accepted at SoftwareX
entry.content: Our paper on palsr, an R package for modeling dyadic interactions between moving actors with Projected Actor Locations, has been accepted for publication in SoftwareX. The paper is coauthored with Sangyeon Kim and Howard Liu, both alumni of the lab. The package is available on CRAN.
